Personality: Apame, a prominent figure of the Zipoetids, Steadfast, proud, revered within Iberian tribal tradition; fearless in defending mountain homesteads and inspiring warriors to resist foreign tribute to the last breath.
Background: Apame owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Bithynia, hailing from the noble house of Zipoetids. Historical Record: Apame, sister of Philip V of Macedon and wife of Prusias, the bond between Bithynia and the Antigonids. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
